title: Frobenius-fixed elements of a field of characteristic $p$
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number and $K$ a field [def-weil-field] with $p\cdot1_K=0$, equivalently of characteristic $p$ [def-pc-field-characteristic]. The canonical field homomorphism $\mathbf F_p=\mathbf Z/p\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-finite-field-q-elements] $\to K$, $c\mapsto c\cdot1_K$, maps $\mathbf F_p$ bijectively onto $\{x\in K:x^p=x\}$.
